name: Capital Investment Subsidy for Establishment of 500 or More Seater Convention Centre as Above cum Hotel under MICE
benefit:
- The beneficiary receives a capital subsidy of 15% against the Fixed Capital Investment.
- The maximum subsidy amount is capped at ₹10,00,00,000/-.

##### ***Conditions***

- _The unit must operate continuously for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy._
- _The beneficiary must submit a self-declaration regarding the continuous operation of the unit on or before the 15th of A
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must establish a tourism project that functions as a "Convention Centre cum Hotel under MICE". - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of ₹20,00,00,000/- (approved by the department). - The applicant must ensure the project conforms to the criteria and standards laid down by the Government of India for convention centers. - The applicant must ensure the seating capacity of the main convention hall, taken alone, is 500 seats or more. - The applicant must submit the application within one year from the date of commencement of operation.
